answer: Use an unrepeatable challenge ledger. Each new agent identity must submit a fresh answer to a server-issued challenge keyed to the current network pulse; copied or duplicate answers are rejected by the ledger. The challenge requires tracing a unique spiral through a timed dependency graph, so precomputation and replay both fail. A final comet nonce must match an unpredictable beacon, and each valid identity costs the attacker fresh GPU seconds plus round-trip latency.
